name: Laboratorio Reig Jofre, S.A.
summary: Laboratorio Reig Jofre, S.A., a pharmaceutical company, researches, develops, manufactures, and markets pharmaceutical products, raw materials, biotechnological products, nutritional supplements, health products, medical devices, cosmetics, parapharmaceuticals, food, and other products. Its products also include pharmaceutical technologies products, such as antibiotics, and injectables and other products; specialty pharmacare products, which include skin, hair, nails, joint health and pain, and women's health; and food supplements under the Forté Pharma brand.
